children: Electromed’s revenue and net income increased year over year in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. Higher homecare volume, driven by additional sales representatives and increased productivity, lifted revenue and gross profit; improved revenue mix also supported gross margin. Higher SG&A and research and development expenses partly offset the gains.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Revenue rose 17.6%, driven by additional sales representatives and increased productivity; the company averaged 63 homecare field sales representatives.
: Revenue declined 31.6% as prior-year large capital purchases did not recur, partly offset by higher disposable volume.
: Gross profit reached $14.9M, or 80.0% of net revenues, versus $13.2M, or 78.1%; improved mix lifted the margin.
: Homecare distributor revenue fell 55.9%, primarily due to the timing of distributor purchases.
